about.heading: About me
about.text: I'm Fakhar Alam, a video editor who helps coaches and personal brands turn simple talking-head footage into content people actually watch till the end. I build every edit around the story, with kinetic captions, clean motion graphics, b-roll and pacing that keeps viewers hooked. From talking-head reels and VOX style explainers to AI videos and social posts, my goal is simple: make your message clear, sharp and impossible to scroll past.
